enquiry: We want to monitor water content in a clear ethanol-water stream in our solvent recovery unit. Water content is between 0.5 and 5 % w/w, the line runs at 25 °C in a DN50 stainless steel pipe, and the analyzer can sit in a control room about 20 m away. Our reference is Karl Fischer titration in the lab, and we need an updated value every minute.

clarification_questions.question: What goes wrong today in the solvent recovery unit without a continuous water value, and which decision would the minute-by-minute water value drive (for example, adjusting the column or stopping off-spec product)?
clarification_questions.why: Defines the decision the sensor must support and therefore the required accuracy and response.
clarification_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Decision unknown; the first conversation establishes whether the value is for process control, quality release or monitoring only.

clarification_questions.question: Besides water, which other components are present in the ethanol-water stream and at what levels, and is the 0.5 to 5 % w/w range the expected operating range or a design envelope?
clarification_questions.why: Other components can overlap spectrally with water and change the calibration needed.
clarification_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Only ethanol and water assumed; lab screening establishes whether other components interfere.

clarification_questions.question: Does the stream stay clear under all operating conditions, or can bubbles, turbidity, colour or solids appear?
clarification_questions.why: Clarity determines whether transmission, transflection or ATR geometry is suitable.
clarification_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Clear liquid as stated; occasional bubbles or turbidity not yet excluded.

clarification_questions.question: What are the flow rate, pressure and operating temperature range in the DN50 line, and is there fouling, deposition or a cleaning-in-place procedure?
clarification_questions.why: Pressure, flow and fouling affect probe mounting, cleaning and signal stability.
clarification_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Stated 25 °C only; pressure, flow and fouling unknown and to be confirmed on site.

clarification_questions.question: Where exactly can the measurement be installed on the DN50 line (tap, flow cell or bypass), can a probe contact the liquid, and what cabling or fiber already runs from the pipe to the control room?
clarification_questions.why: The installation point and contact possibility determine the probe type and whether a fiber link of about 20 m is needed.
clarification_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Installation point and contact not known; remote measurement with an existing or new cable link is to be checked.

clarification_questions.question: How is the Karl Fischer reference sampled (timing, sample volume, lab turnaround), what accuracy does it achieve, and are historical paired data available for calibration?
clarification_questions.why: The reference accuracy sets the achievable target and historical paired data are needed for any calibration.
clarification_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Reference accuracy and sampling frequency unknown; paired reference data for model building assumed not available yet.

clarification_questions.question: What accuracy, response time and budget are required for the online water measurement, and is the one-minute update the only timing requirement?
clarification_questions.why: These requirements decide whether a single-method solution is sufficient and what scope is realistic.
clarification_questions.assumption_if_unanswered: Accuracy, response time and budget unknown; the one-minute update is the only timing requirement stated so far.

rule_hints: nominal_range_not_instrument_range: A nominal method range is not the usable range of a specific instrument, fiber or probe. [DOCX §3; DOCX §5]

fiber_limits_wavelength: The fiber determines which wavelengths reach the probe. Silica fibers transmit up to about 2.4 um and cannot carry mid-IR; mid-IR needs chalcogenide, polycrystalline or hollow-waveguide fibers. [S02 p.6; S04 p.1; DOCX §5]
remote_measurement_nir_silica: NIR works with standard glass optics and silica fibers, which suits remote online measurement; robust silica cables of 100-300 m exist. [S01 p.5; S02 p.7]

geometry_follows_optics: Clear liquids suit transmission or transflection; opaque, concentrated or powder samples suit diffuse reflection; highly absorbing or 'black' liquids suit ATR. [S01 Table 1 (p.6); S01 p.16; S01 p.17-18]
do_not_invent: Do not invent measured results, accuracy, detection limits, response times, fiber lengths, product codes or prices, client facts, or guarantees. [DOCX §3]
